# mori

> mori tends a forest of git and jj worktrees for you and your coding agents: one clone per repo in
> a fixed layout, an owner and a lifetime for every tree, and cleanup that never loses a change.
> Pre-alpha: anything may change in any release.

## Using mori

- [Install and release channels](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/install/): head (every commit on main, what we dogfood) and the planned tagged releases
- [Disk usage tips](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/disk-usage/): what mori shows and does about disk, the caches to set up for each language so trees share their builds, and Docker and OrbStack cleanup
- [Shared caches](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/shared-caches/): set build caches at the user level so every tree shares them, and clean up Bazel output left by deleted trees
- [Skills index](https://github.com/nevzheng/mori/blob/main/skills/llms.txt): every agent skill mori ships, one `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` each
- [Disk usage (agent skill)](https://github.com/nevzheng/mori/blob/main/skills/disk-usage/SKILL.md): measuring, freeing space safely and passing on cache warnings
- [Using mori (agent skill)](https://github.com/nevzheng/mori/blob/main/skills/using-mori/SKILL.md): commands, JSON output, errors and the rules agents follow
- [README](https://github.com/nevzheng/mori/blob/main/README.md): what mori is and how to build it

## Design

- [The forest layout and tree model](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/design/core/forest-layout-and-tree-model/): where mori keeps repos and trees, and what it records
- [How design docs work](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/design/): the SPIP format and statuses

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nevzheng/mori/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working rules for agents and humans changing mori
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://nevzheng.github.io/mori/contributing/): how to propose and send changes
